name: Modular Sci-Fi Corridor
description:
# Modular Sci-Fi Corridor

Reusable Blender scene: 4-meter modular sci-fi corridor segment with PBR steel materials, recessed wall lighting, and a procedural floor grate via geometry nodes. Designed to be duplicated end-to-end via array modifier to build longer corridors. Uses the EEVEE render engine for fast iteration.

## Key components
- Wall segments: hard-surface mesh with bevelled edges + emissive panel inserts
- Floor: geometry-nodes grate driven by a noise texture for varied wear
- Lighting: emissive material on the recessed strips + a single area light overhead
applicability: Reusable sci-fi corridor scene with PBR materials, modular array-friendly geometry, and EEVEE-ready lighting.

name: Archviz Living Room
description:
# Archviz Living Room

Interior architectural-visualisation reference scene: a 5x4-meter living room with Scandinavian furnishings, large window with HDRI sun light, and a hardwood floor with procedural variation. Cycles render setup pre-configured with denoising. Suitable as a starting point for any modern interior scene.

## Camera setups
- View 1: 35mm hero shot of the seating arrangement
- View 2: wide-angle establishing shot through the doorway
applicability: Interior architectural visualisation scene with Scandinavian furnishings, HDRI sun lighting, and Cycles render setup.

name: Low-Poly Landscape
description:
# Low-Poly Landscape

Stylised low-poly landscape: faceted terrain with 3 elevation tiers (water, plain, mountain), 5 cone-style trees scattered via geometry nodes, and a procedural sky with two sun positions. Flat-shaded materials for the signature low-poly look. Renders quickly in EEVEE for animation work.
applicability: Stylised low-poly landscape with terrain tiers, scattered trees, and EEVEE-friendly flat-shaded materials.
